description: Submit one finding as a DRAFT. It enters the librarian's review like any research run and never touches canon directly. A claim with no sources is refused (error no_sources). Requires a patron with write access.

claim.description: The claim itself, one to three self-contained sentences.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

sources.description: Where it comes from: URLs, edition citations, or {locator, edition, why} objects.

title.description: Optional short title (default: the claim's first words).

triple.description: Optional {subject, predicate, object}: the claim as an edge of the graph (library_map). Without it the nightly triples crew derives one.

name: library_submit
